question: Predict the final VS Code issue-tracker triage disposition from the initial submission. Use only the supplied title and body.
context: A question/support disposition includes reports that should be redirected to support or discussion because the text does not establish a VS Code product defect, even when the author calls it a bug.

criteria.bug: An existing VS Code behavior appears broken, incorrect, crashing, or regressed. Not usage help, configuration support, external-code problems, or a request for new behavior.
criteria.feature: The author requests a new capability or a deliberate change to VS Code behavior. Not a failure of existing behavior or a request for help using existing functionality.
criteria.question: Usage, configuration, troubleshooting, or support/discussion that should be redirected from the issue tracker. Not a sufficiently described VS Code product defect or clear product enhancement.
